vaulttecmediaoptimizer-admin: Display name of the vaulttecmediaoptimizer-admin user right.
group-vaulttecmediaoptimizer-admin: Name of the user group with vaulttecmediaoptimizer-admin permission.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-status-intro: Intro text on the status page.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-status-section-zo: Section heading on the status page for the optional zopflipng feature checks.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-status-has-failur: Summary line when failures are present. $1 is the failure count.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-status-has-warnin: Summary line when warnings are present. $1 is the warning count.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-status-create-web: Label for the button that creates the WebP directory.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-status-action-bac: Link label to the backfill page.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-status-action-sta: Link label to the stats page.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-backfill-title: Page title for the backfill special page.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-backfill-intro: Intro paragraph on the backfill page.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-backfill-schedule: Confirmation after scheduling all files. $1 is a number.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-backfill-progress: Progress bar label. $1 = processed count, $2 = total, $3 = percentage.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-backfill-complete: Completion message. $1 = files processed, $2 = formatted size saved.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-backfill-processe: Stat label: number of processed files.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-backfill-pending: Stat label: number of pending files.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-backfill-failed: Stat label: number of failed files.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-backfill-skipped: Stat label: number of skipped files.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-backfill-queue-in: Job queue status. $1 = pending job count.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-backfill-queued: Stat label: number of queued jobs.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-backfill-reset-do: Confirmation after resetting failed files. $1 is a number.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-backfill-zopfli-h: Heading for the zopflipng recompression section on the backfill page.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-backfill-zopfli-e: Explanatory note under the PNG recompression heading on the backfill page. $1 is the active engine name (e.g. oxipng or zopflipng).
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-backfill-zopfli-s: Label for the button that schedules PNG recompression. $1 is the active engine name; $2 is the number of pending PNG originals.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-backfill-zopfli-i: Confirmation banner after scheduling recompression jobs. $1 is a count.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-backfill-zopfli-n: Banner shown when there are no PNGs left to recompress.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-backfill-rate-hin: Hint about $wgJobRunRate to speed up processing.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-backfill-no-eligi: Shown when there are no files left to schedule.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-title: Page title for the stats special page.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-intro: Intro paragraph on the stats page.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-space-saved: Card label: space saved on originals.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-space-webp: Card label: space used by WebP files.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-bandwidth-s: Card label: bandwidth saved per WebP download.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-compression: Section heading for compression ratio bars.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-ratio-lossl: Label for the lossless optimization ratio bar.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-ratio-webp: Label for the WebP size ratio bar.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-ratio-savin: Saving percentage label. $1 is a number.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-by-format: Section heading for the per-format breakdown table.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-zopfli-head: Section heading for zopflipng recompression stats.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-zopfli-tota: Card label: total bytes reclaimed by zopflipng.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-zopfli-orig: Card label: number of original PNGs recompressed.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-zopfli-thum: Card label: number of thumbnail PNGs recompressed.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-failed-file: Section heading: list of failed files.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-no-data: Shown when no data is available yet.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-check-vips: Check label: whether the optional libvips binary is usable.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-check-image-engin: Check label: which image backend (auto/vips) is configured.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-check-jobqueue: Check label: whether uploads enqueue optimization jobs.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-check-zopfli-enab: Status check label: whether the zopflipng feature toggle is on.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-check-png-engine: Status check label: which engine (zopflipng/oxipng) is selected for PNG recompression.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-check-zopfli-shel: Status check label: whether PHP shell execution functions are available for zopflipng.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-check-zopfli-bina: Status check label: whether the zopflipng binary is found and executable.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-msg-webp-dir-miss: Warning that WebP directory is missing. $1 = directory path.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-msg-webp-dir-not-: Warning that WebP directory is not writable. $1 = directory path.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-msg-table-missing: Error: database table missing; run update.php.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-msg-memory-low: Warning about low PHP memory limit. $1 = current limit (e.g. '128M').
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-msg-filebackend-r: Error shown when the wiki uses a non-filesystem file backend incompatible with the extension.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-log-backfill-star: Log line. $1 = number of jobs scheduled.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-overview-he: Heading for the overview statistics table.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-col-indicat: Column header for the indicator name in key/value stats tables.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-col-value: Column header for the value in key/value stats tables.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-space-saved: Label: total disk space saved from the uploaded original to the current file (all passes combined).
Label: disk space saved by the second pass (oxipng/zopflipng) only.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-disk-headin: Heading for the disk-space balance section.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-disk-saved: Label: space saved by optimizing original files.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-disk-webp: Label: space occupied by generated WebP files (originals).
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-disk-balanc: Label: net signed disk-space balance (saved minus WebP added).
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-disk-note-n: Explanatory note shown when the disk balance is negative.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-disk-note-p: Explanatory note shown when the disk balance is positive.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-bw-heading: Heading for the per-page bandwidth estimate section.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-bw-assumpti: Label for the simulation assumption row.
Value describing the simulated page. $1 is the thumbnail count; $2 is the per-thumbnail size.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-bw-original: Label: total weight of the page's images in their original format.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-bw-webp: Label: total weight of the page's images in WebP.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-bw-saved: Label: bandwidth saved per page by serving WebP.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-bw-note: Explanatory note clarifying the per-page bandwidth estimate is illustrative.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-ratio-col-r: Column header: resulting size as a percentage of the source.
